title: Agriculture Minister Yana resigns about a month after taking office, taking responsibility for budget cut remarks and political funds scandals
summary: Facing criticism over a series of scandals and controversial remarks, Agriculture Minister Yana submitted his resignation in effect of a dismissal.

title: Author Senji Kuroi passes away at 94, a representative literary figure of the "Introverted Generation"
summary: The novelist, known for a writing style that deeply examines the human interior, has passed away.

title: Russian authorities detain Hokkaido Shimbun reporter on espionage charges, government to protest
summary: The move is seen as part of pressure surrounding the situation in Ukraine, and the Foreign Ministry and other agencies are scrambling to respond.
